content: DECISION (2026-06-26, /think spec exported + agentfront#35 filed, SUPERSEDES earlier full-migration framing): colleague will build its agent-first CLI by IMPORTING agentfront, MCP a free bonus. VERIFIED BLOCKER: agentfront 0.11.1 App.cli() = learn/doctor only; @app.tool is MCP/HTTP-only never CLI-dispatched; rich CLI machinery PRIVATE to agentfront.cli, no consumer hook (caught by ask-colleague explore, 5/5; verified vs cli_surface.make_cli:105/109). PATH = UPSTREAM-FIRST: agentfront publishes a public consumer CLI API FIRST (filed as agentculture/agentfront#35), THEN colleague imports it. CLI is PRIMARY; MCP(server, for Cowork)+HTTP are BONUSES from the same App registry. PACKAGING: agentfront=one base dep (pure-stdlib); mcp SDK+daemon behind colleague[mcp] extra (opt-in, base binds no socket); test_zero_deps allow-lists exactly agentfront. ENV CONSTRAINT: other-repo changes are DROPPED in this session, so agentfront Phase-1 done ELSEWHERE; colleague Phase-2 specd here but GATED on agentfront#35. Spec committed on branch spec/agentfront-import (commits d3fd83e conventions, a2385f5 spec). Deliverable this session=spec+filed precondition issue, NOT colleague impl (blocked). Next: when agentfront#35 ships, spike to confirm coverage, then /spec-to-plan colleague Phase-2.

GOTCHA (2026-06-27, colleague v1.27.0, commit 4f9a26b): agentfront 0.15.0 added Flag(choices=) (issue #38 Ask 1), but it does NOT enable parse-time choices on a VALUE-CARRYING flag in a rendered tool — a flag whose value the function consumes via its signature param. agentfront derives a CLI arg from EACH signature param and its dispatcher forwards ONLY signature params. Empirically vs installed 0.15.0: Shape A (sig param `algo` + explicit Flag([--algo],choices=)) COLLIDES at build (argparse `conflicting option string: --algo`; agentfront sets no conflict_handler=resolve). Shape B (Flag-only --algo, NOT in signature — agentfront own test shape in test_cli_surface._checksum_app) validates the choice but SILENTLY DROPS the value (dispatcher never forwards a non-signature arg). add_command is top-level-only, so converting the noun to a host command (which would get native argparse choices) would EVICT the whole noun from the MCP/learn catalog — wrong trade. RESOLUTION in colleague: validate --algo EXPLICITLY + EARLY inside the verb (commands/hooks approve) — a clean choices-shaped CliError against the new public colleague.policy.SUPPORTED_CHECKSUM_ALGOS tuple, raised before any file/name lookup. A fully general fix would be a further agentfront ask: let an explicit Flag REPLACE a signature-derived arg of the same dest (suppress sig-derivation when an explicit Flag covers it). Public run_tool accessor (Ask 2) WAS cleanly adoptable: app.mcp_server().run_tool replaces the private _build_run_tool in tests.

TAUI uplift (sequel to cli-on-agentfront): colleague imports agentfront.taui instead of hand-rolled colleague/tui. /think spec docs/specs/2026-06-27-colleague-renders-its-cockpit-from-agentfront-s-ta.md (branch spec/taui-on-agentfront, unpushed). Surprise: agentfront ALREADY ships v0.1 TAUI (agentfront/taui/, v0.17.0) with 12 documented parity gaps (test_taui_colleague_parity.py) vs colleague v0.2. Operator decisions: full uplift (snapshot/replay/7-class diagnose/moon-phase/_collapse_repeat all go UP) + big-bang + colleague-does-consumer-side-only. agentfront work delegated upstream as agentfront#43; colleague-side resume brief is colleague#249 (gated on agentfront release). Keep adapter from_work.py+cockpit.py; delete generic colleague/tui modules; rewrite session.py in-place mutations to dataclasses.replace (frozen, gap 11).

Spec (devague /think) converged+committed on branch spec/modes-fit-the-machine (a15eea7, unpushed): work modes fit the machine. Six requirements each filed as an issue: #254 per-mode constraint profiles (runtime, EngineConfig default layer; replaces ask-colleague.sh caller-side env overrides), #255 adaptive compute backpressure (turn-latency trigger; mechanism for #229; tighten-only, no router), #256 three-tier visibility parity (capacity gauge + phase + goal + mode; upstream-first agentfront TAUIState bump), #257 budget-aware skill curation (populate role skill_subset — today all None; token-capped compose with omitted-N note), #258 subagent budget scaling + rig-level file-based concurrency budget (+ read-only batches skip merge slot), #259 tasks carry their goal (Task.goal/acceptance, acceptance_outcomes advisory, lineage, plan continue). Also evidence comment on #66.
